source_order.fact: SDIRK3 namelist configuration and wrf_sdirk3_load_env_once occur before the dedicated WRF dynamics-flag forwarding calls.
The Fortran config_flags%non_hydrostatic and config_flags%do_curvature values are explicitly forwarded after environment loading and before tile solver construction.
The bool setter writes those exact names into g_sdirk3_config and emits [CONFIG] values.
Each tile solver snapshots non_hydrostatic_ from g_sdirk3_config after the Fortran setter path.
computeUnifiedRHS defines native_nh = non_hydrostatic_ && canonical_horizontal and guards native nonhydrostatic pressure additions with it.
The U-PGF observation serializes the actual per-call native_nh boolean in the capture header.
Curvature branches read g_sdirk3_config.do_curvature directly during computeUnifiedRHS.
The config setter refuses changes after workers are started.

runtime_log.interpretation: Lines 295-300 are emitted during load_env_once before the explicit WRF setter calls at module_implicit_sdirk3.F:629-632. The later lines are setter echoes, consistent with source order; they are not evidence of a false setting at Full evaluation.

conclusions.native_nonhydrostatic_u_pgf: directly confirmed active by captured native_nh=1; source formula requires the instance flag and canonical horizontal geometry
conclusions.curvature_control: source/log chronology supports g_sdirk3_config.do_curvature=true at computeUnifiedRHS; no per-call curvature bit is serialized, so this is control-path provenance rather than an observed nonzero curvature contribution
